messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: billing.overages.alert (a1234) — multiple overage emails sent to customer acme-corp in the last 15m. Paging on-call @oncall-evan. Severity: P1. Please acknowledge and triage.
oncall-evan: Ack. I'm on it. Starting runbooks for billing spike.
sarah-billing: Noticed a jump in flagged accounts around 1719991200-1719992000, counts ~+320% vs baseline. Looking at token agg stream now.
priya-ingest: I see a backlog in emitter-kafka partition-7 from upstream proxy. There was a consumer restart ~1719991005 that may have replayed ~30k messages.
mike-platform: Could be double-emission causing inflated token counts. Any chance the dedupe window was shortened in the latest deploy?
sarah-billing: We rolled a small perf tweak yesterday that reduced idempotency TTL from 10m->2m for throughput. That would allow replays to be counted again.
oncall-evan: If that's true we should toggle the flag to restore TTL to 10m. Can someone flip the feature flag and monitor?
priya-ingest: I can flip it. Toggling feature: feature.toggle id=ingest.dedupe_ttl -> 600s (was 120s)
priya-ingest: done. Confirmed feature flag change propagated to all ingest workers.
sarah-billing: Recomputing a sampled customer's ledger (acme-corp) — pre-fix tokens: 1,240,112; post-fix stream (dedupe applied) sample: 42,119. Looks like replay-induced duplication.
nathan-support: Customer-facing alert already sent by ops: "We're investigating billing email spike; no action required from customers." Should we send an update?
alex-product: Let's wait for 30m of stable telemetry after the TTL change and then send a corrective note if counts settle. Legal/finance will need accurate numbers before any refund.
mike-platform: Running a compact job to remove replayed events from the shadow ledger where dedupe key indicates repeated seq. Command run: ```./tools/ledger-clean --sample acme-corp --dry-run```
mike-platform: Dry-run shows ~29k duplicate tokens removable. Scheduling a conservative non-blocking cleanup in 15m window.
sarah-billing: Temporarily pausing overage-email worker for affected accounts to avoid further noise. paused workers: overage-dispatcher-3
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager rotation updated — escalations to platform lead if no recovery by 20m.
priya-ingest: Kafka offsets stabilized, consumer lag back to <100. No more replay spikes in last 5m.
oncall-evan: Good. Keep monitoring. Sarah, can you confirm whether any invoices already issued?
sarah-billing: No invoices charged yet — only notifications. Finance confirmed holds until we resolve.
nathan-support: I'll prep a short customer update draft in #support-drafts and ping legal.
alex-product: After 30m stable window, we'll run full ledger reconcile for affected accounts and decide on refund/credit. Track runbook steps in the incident doc.
mike-platform: Cleanup started (non-blocking) at 1719993300. Progress: 12% -> 47% -> 100% (completed). Verified duplicates removed for sample.
sarah-billing: Post-cleanup checks: flagged accounts reduced to baseline +/- 8%. Overage emails halted.
oncall-evan: Confirmed recovery. Moving to monitoring and root-cause analysis. Leaving the incident open for RCA notes and postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident a1234 status -> mitigated at 1719993480. Please fill in the postmortem template in /wiki/incidents/a1234 when ready. :white_check_mark:
